summary: Iteration 17 full test: attendance self-service (/mesai), company + per-employee work schedules, auto overtime/late/early-leave calculation, confirm/dispute flow, RBAC skip paths, and banking retest (bank_match immutability, auto-match account filter, connection testids, BankMatchRow options). Backend: 22/22 pytest assertions passed (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration17.py). Frontend: /mesai and /personnel Puantaj tab and /banking connections all verified via Playwright with geolocation grant; no console errors anywhere.

ui_bugs.issue: ?tab=attendance query param is ignored — tab state is useState('payroll') with no URL sync, so the dispute notification link '/personnel?tab=attendance' (attendance.py dispute_attendance) lands on the payroll tab. Manager must click Puantaj manually.

After a personnel dispute, the row only shows 'İtiraz edildi' and the 'Onayla' button disappears, so the employee cannot later confirm/withdraw the objection (record stays unconfirmed forever from the employee side). Backend /confirm still works, so this is only a UI gating decision.

issues: ws-start/ws-end use native <input type=time> which renders in 12-hour AM/PM format (08:45 AM / 05:45 PM) in the test browser locale while the rest of the Turkish UI shows 24-hour times (e.g. table badge '08:45-17:45') — inconsistent; consider step/format hint or a 24h-forced control.

action_items: Sync PersonnelPage tab with URL query (?tab=attendance) so the 'Puantaj itirazı' notification deep link opens the Puantaj tab.
Decide whether an employee can confirm a record after disputing it (currently Onayla button is hidden after dispute in /mesai).
critical_code_review_comments: DRY: haversine + geo check-in/out logic is duplicated — server.py `_haversine_m` and `/api/personnel/attendance/geo` duplicate attendance.py `haversine_m` and `/api/personnel/attendance/self` (~40 duplicated lines incl. duplicate/late/early validation). Keep only the attendance.py self endpoint and let the legacy /geo route delegate to it.
File size: /app/backend/server.py is 4362 lines (>700 limit). Attendance/banking blocks should move to modules like attendance.py did.

attendance.py apply_day stores schedule_snapshot but existing records are never recalculated when the company schedule changes; confirm this is intended (UI toast says 'Yeni giriş/çıkışlar bu saatlere göre hesaplanır', so it appears intended).

put_work_schedule ignores unknown/extra keys silently and always resets missing keys to DEFAULT_SCHEDULE (a PUT with only {start,end} wipes previously customised break/tolerances). Consider merging with current company schedule instead of DEFAULT_SCHEDULE.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows working; 1 deep-link + 1 minor UX gap)
